purpose: Six original text-free visual scenes for a research-grounded Hindi explanation of proposed attention mechanisms.
sourcePolicy: All approved scenes were generated as original AI visuals. Captions were composited separately at render time; no scene contains embedded text, logos, watermarks, brands, medical claims, or real-person imitation.
recoveryDisclosure: The first multi-scene generation for scenes 2–6 returned literal failure placeholders. Those placeholders were rejected, preserved outside the approved input set, and recorded in REEL-0004_qc.md. Scenes 2–6 below are the successful single recovery batch generated with approved scene 1 as a style reference.
